assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known atrial fibrillation and a personal history of transient ischemic attacks
The diagnosis codes are I48.91 and G45.9
CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring) is ordered
The service is ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with arrhythmic events and to optimize rate control and anticoagulation management
The denial is under Reason Code PR-204 that this service is not covered under the beneficiary's current benefit plan
